answer_1.quote: With the exploitation of large amounts of training data, neural machine translation (NMT) models have shown promising quality.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU to validate translation performance.

answer_4.quote: Each sentence is scored by three professional translators presented with pairs of a source sentence and a translated hypothesis, following the scoring criteria ranging from 1 to 5 (larger is better) in previous work.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation of translation quality mainly focuses on two aspects: accuracy and fluency.
